II p187.text: It is in a beautiful soul that sensuousness and reason, duty and inclination are in harmony, and grace is their expression as appearance.

transcription.original_text: It is in a beautiful soul that sensuousness and reason, duty and inclination are in harmony, and grace is their expression as appearance.

II p187.alignment: A beautiful soul brings sensuousness and reason, duty and inclination into harmony; grace is their expression in appearance. German ihr can refer to the singular soul or the enumerated faculties, while English their directs the reference to the latter; this ambiguity is disclosed for comparison.

Independently opened the German 1793 pp. 187–188 and Curran p. 153. The whole 23-word sentence, spelling and punctuation match the page, with no italic emphasis. The paired faculties and their harmony and expression as appearance correspond. German ihr can refer to the singular beautiful soul or the enumerated faculties, whereas their explicitly selects the latter; the project interpretation selects the former. SEP identifies Curran and the page, and LOC nr96025122 identifies the full name.
